newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares gain before ITC results.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares gain before ITC results.

text.p: Delhi stocks rose in early trade on Tuesday as foreign and domestic investors made hectic purchases of shares of cigarette maker ITC Ltd on expectations of strong 1996/97 results, brokers said.

The Delhi Stock Exchange's benchmark index was up 2.26 points at 782.86 after 30 minutes of trade. ITC, which was to announce its 1996/97 (April-March) results later on Tuesday, was up 5.60 rupees at 453.
"Foreign investors indulged in creating huge positions in ITC as the company is likely to come out with excellent performance later today," said Ashok Arya of brokers S.C. Gupta and Co.

Analysts in Bombay said they expected ITC's 1996/97 net profit to rise to between 3.4 billion and 4.0 billion rupees from 2.61 billion in 1995/96, reflecting strong margins in tobacco and cigarette sales.
Reliance Industries was up one rupee to 298.30.
Bajaj Auto fell eight rupees to 862 on foreign institutional selling.
